params.body:
Printing the takeover agreement ("overeenkomst van overname") from the bidding screen 500ed on production since ee6a5438 (2026-09-13):

```
SQLSTATE[42S22]: Unknown column 'name' in 'SELECT' … select name, id from option_values where id in (…)
```

`Vehicle::agreementOptionLines()` plucked `name` from the query builder, but `option_values` has no `name` column: it is an accessor over `name_nl`/`name_fr`/… by locale. The old template called `OptionValues::find($id)->name` per option and went through the accessor.

**Fix** (`app/Models/Vehicle/Vehicle.php`): load the models (`->get()`, still one query) and map through the accessor. Only integer-like `option_value`s are looked up as ids; free text and decimals such as the `4.6` seen in the production query print as their own text, exactly what `find()` returning null gave before. `VehicleOptions::agreementLines` is unchanged.

**Tests**: `tests/Feature/AgreementOptionLinesTest.php` (`@rule B1-6.2`): dropdown value prints its localized name (nl and en), a decimal passes through, checkbox options are left out, and the full `export.print.agreement_print` template renders for such a vehicle. Fails on main with the production error, green here.

**Finding**: `docs/bedrijfsregels/bevindingen/2026-09-15-overeenkomst-van-overname-afdrukken-gaf-500.md` (opgelost, ernst nu).

Filter run: `Agreement|Export|Bidding|Option|RulesCoverage|RulesIdentity`: OK (90 tests, 270 assertions).

The borderel form redesign from the same brief follows in a second PR.
params.title: The takeover agreement prints again
